title.en: Foam rubber is an outline for HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm, not a second table
title.zh: 《Foam rubber》是HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm的大纲，不是第二张表

description.en: Section titles come from Foam rubber; the HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm figures stay the printed ones. HBT80-16 is an HBT-series trailer pump made in Xingtai. Only this page, not the Electric 80 page, prints delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm. Wall thickness is not printed.
description.zh: 节标题来自《Foam rubber》，HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm的数字仍是已印数字。HBT80-16 是邢台制造的 HBT 系列拖泵。印出输送管 100 / 125 mm 的是这一页，不是电动80那一页。壁厚没有印出。

h1.en: Foam rubber sets the order for the HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm note
h1.zh: 《Foam rubber》决定这篇HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm笔记的次序

directAnswer.en: The short answer for HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm uses the cells Xingtai already printed. Foam rubber is the outline those cells are filed under. HBT80-16 is an HBT-series trailer pump made in Xingtai. Only this page, not the Electric 80 page, prints delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm. Wall thickness is not printed.
directAnswer.zh: HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm的简答只用邢台已经印出的格子。《Foam rubber》是这些格子所依的大纲。 HBT80-16 是邢台制造的 HBT 系列拖泵。印出输送管 100 / 125 mm 的是这一页，不是电动80那一页。壁厚没有印出。

body.en: “Manufacturing history” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. The sheet prints motor 110 kW, output 50 m³/h, pumping pressure 40 MPa, horizontal conveying 120 m, delivery height 360 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm, size 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm, weight 6500 kg. The 120 m cell is horizontal distance. Order the spare from the Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe page. That page is a red straight pipe with reinforced coupling ends. It has no fixed diameter table and no wall thickness. Electric 80 prints the same secondary code HBT80-1816-110, with 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa and 900 m / 300 m, and no pipe-diameter cell. Copy 100 / 125 mm only when the inquiry is for HBT80-16. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: “制造历史”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 参数表印出电机 110 kW、输送量 50 m³/h、泵送压力 40 MPa、水平输送 120 m、输送高度 360 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、输送管 100 / 125 mm、外形 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm、重量 6500 kg。120 m 是水平距离。 直管从混凝土泵输送管页询价。那一页是带加强快接端的红色直管，没有固定管径表，也没有壁厚。电动80印了同一个副代号 HBT80-1816-110，参数是 110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、900 m / 300 m，没有管径格。只有询价对象是 HBT80-16 时才抄 100 / 125 mm。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: “Manufacturing process” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Send this model name, the inner diameter printed on its own page, the length you need, and the quantity. Do not send a wall thickness. HBT80-16 is an HBT-series trailer pump made in Xingtai. Only this page, not the Electric 80 page, prints delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm. Wall thickness is not printed. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “制造过程”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写上这一型号、它自己页面上的内径、需要的长度和数量。不要填写壁厚。 HBT80-16 是邢台制造的 HBT 系列拖泵。印出输送管 100 / 125 mm 的是这一页，不是电动80那一页。壁厚没有印出。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: “Physical properties” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. No. The spare page has no fixed size table. The figure comes from this model's specification cell. No. A metre figure for horizontal or vertical conveying is distance, not a cut length for the spare. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “物理性能”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 不是。直管页没有固定尺寸表。数字来自这一型号参数表上的格子。 不是。水平或垂直的米数是输送距离，不是配件的截取长度。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “Recycling” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. Neither is printed. Both are missing fields. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The outline does not complete a blank. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foam_rubber
body.zh: “回收”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 都没有印。两项都是缺字段。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 大纲补不上空白格子。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foam_rubber

question.en: Which printed fragment stays in force when the section is “Physical properties” for HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm?
question.zh: 章节为“物理性能”时，HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm仍以哪一句已印文字为准？

answer.en: No. The spare page has no fixed size table. The figure comes from this model's specification cell. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。直管页没有固定尺寸表。数字来自这一型号参数表上的格子。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: What should an inquiry repeat for HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm under the heading “Recycling”?
question.zh: 询价HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm时，在“回收”这一节应当重复什么？

answer.en: No. A metre figure for horizontal or vertical conveying is distance, not a cut length for the spare. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。水平或垂直的米数是输送距离，不是配件的截取长度。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Where does the photograph sit relative to the printed HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm cells?
question.zh: 这张配图相对HBT80-16 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm的已印格子处于什么位置？

answer.en: Neither is printed. Both are missing fields. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
